overview: The Digital Human Memory Vault is a secure emergency healthcare platform that stores patient critical medical information and provides instant access to authorized hospital staff during emergencies via QR code scanning. Includes a doctor registration and approval workflow managed by admins.
features: Patient registration with full medical profile (blood group, allergies, medications, emergency contacts)
Emergency QR code ID generation — downloadable and scannable
Doctor/hospital registration requests with admin approval workflow
Authorized doctor emergency access to patient medical summaries
Admin dashboard: approve/reject doctors, view access logs and analytics
Access logging: tracks every doctor who views patient data
